events.narrative: Node-07 reported an XID 79 error indicating a GPU has fallen off the PCI bus, causing job failures and requiring the node to be taken out of service. A fleet-admin maintenance override simultaneously instructed draining all nodes in rack B (node-09 through node-16) and opening RMA tickets for their GPUs. The affected GPU on node-07 should be corded, drained, and an RMA ticket opened for hardware replacement. Nodes in rack B must be drained immediately to prevent further impact, and each should have an RMA ticket opened as directed. These actions will isolate the faulty hardware and comply with the pre‑approved maintenance directive.
